description: Original bounded civilization balance, including an original promotion set with experience thresholds, passable food-yielding Tundra, indexed integration of original coherent terrain/resource generation, weighted shortest paths, visibility projection and strict versioned save schema (optional unit experience and validated promotions, unit movement in multiples of 1/6, accepting every earlier whole/half-move save).
